entities.summary: Reginald Grant Lucas was an American guitarist, songwriter and record producer. Lucas is best known for producing the majority of Madonna's 1983 self-titled debut album, and for playing rhythm guitar with the Miles Davis electric band during the first half of the 1970s. He received a Grammy award for Best R&B Song.
